page.title: Price Playbook
page.subtitle: Choose exactly what Sarah may say when a caller asks "how much?". Every figure shows where it came from, and nothing is spoken that you have not approved.
page.loadFailed: We couldn't load your price policies.
page.noPermission: You don't have access to price policies.
page.emptyBody: Until you add one, Sarah only quotes from your Live Price Book and otherwise offers a visit. Add a policy to control the exact wording per service.
page.previewHelp: What a caller would hear, for the state you pick below.
page.auditPass: No invented prices, fee disclosed, no pressure or put-downs.
